messages.subject: Error with fitting type 2and 4 interaction space-time model
parts:
Dear all,

I am fitting a spatiotemporal interaction model with covariates assuming negative binomial likelihood for 84 monthly count data from 136 blocks and I also fit other 36 monthly count data from 136 blocks. The INLA all show the following erro:

Error in if (nrep > 1 || ngroup > 1) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/1
Error in if (nrep > 1 || ngroup > 1) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  *** Failed to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.

I've tried a lot but haven't solved this problem, I hope you can provide me with help thanks！

Best regards
Yuki
